ROUTE: Dunlin-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: the two models are effectively tied on relevant capability (MMLU-Pro, GPQA, IFEval, Arena-Hard, and internal evals all differ by less than the noted variance threshold), so capability didn't decide it. The tiebreaker was task-preference fit. This query is warm in tone, playful, and open-ended ("a fun one," novel puzzle framing) with zero harm-adjacent content. Dunlin self-reports rising preference with request warmth and task novelty/latitude, while Curlew reports flat/inconsistent preferences on these dimensions. Since preferences don't affect output quality, routing the warm, fun task to the model that "prefers" it costs nothing and matches the task to the better-suited profile.
